guide.title: User Guide
guide.reading_page_view_body: Browse the Quran as real Mushaf pages, or switch to list view (each ayah in its own card) from the toggle at the top of the page.
guide.reading_swipe_body: Swipe right for the next page and left for the previous one, just like turning pages in a physical Mushaf.
guide.reading_zoom_body: Pinch with two fingers to zoom the page in and out when using the Small or Medium text size.
guide.reading_font_size_body: In Settings, choose Small or Medium (fill the page without scrolling) or Large (scrolls to read the full page).
guide.reading_signs_body: Turn on colored waqf, sajda and Hizb marks from Settings, matching a printed Mushaf.
guide.reading_search_body: Tap to reveal the search bar at the top of the reading page, and search for any surah or Juz' to jump straight to it.
guide.reading_ayah_sheet_body: Long-press any ayah to open its tafsir and translation, and to start listening from that exact ayah.
guide.bookmark_page_body: Tap the bookmark icon at the top of the reading page to drop a manual stop sign on that page, then tap the bookmark icon on the surah list to jump straight back to it anytime.
guide.bookmark_ayah_body: Long-press any ayah to open its tafsir sheet, then tap the bookmark icon to save that exact ayah. Tap the bookmark icon on the Quran tab to jump straight back to it anytime — the ayah shows highlighted in gold.
guide.khatm_page_body: After the last page of Surah An-Nas, you'll find a closing Khatm al-Quran dua page — that's the true end, so there's nothing more to swipe to.
guide.audio_reciter_body: Pick your preferred reciter from the reciter list inside the reading page, or from Settings.
guide.audio_play_body: Play a whole surah, or start listening from a specific ayah via that ayah's tafsir sheet.
guide.audio_offline_body: In Settings, download the whole Mushaf in your chosen reciter's voice so recitation works without an internet connection.
guide.prayer_times_body: The 5 daily prayer times are calculated automatically from your location.
guide.prayer_qiblah_body: A live compass points toward the Qiblah, turning green once you're facing it. If the direction looks off, move your phone in a figure-8 motion to calibrate the compass.
guide.athkar_daily_body: A new hadith every day with its source, plus a history of the last 14 days.
guide.athkar_tabs_body: Morning, evening, after-prayer, sleep, Jumu'ah sunan, general duaa, and Khatm al-Quran — each item has a tap-to-count repeat counter.
guide.hadith_body: A dedicated tab for the daily hadith with its full text and source, plus a history of the last 14 days.
guide.notif_athan_body: A notification with the athan sound at each of the 5 daily prayer times, with the athan voice selectable from Settings.
guide.notif_athkar_reminders_body: A reminder 30 minutes after Fajr for the morning athkar, 30 minutes after Asr for the evening athkar, a weekly Jumu'ah sunan reminder, and a daily sleep athkar reminder.
guide.notif_hadith_body: A daily notification with the full text of that day's hadith, at the time you choose in Settings.
guide.notif_tap_body: Tapping any notification — athan, morning/evening athkar, Jumu'ah sunan, or the daily hadith — takes you straight to its page in the app.
guide.general_language_body: Switch between Arabic and English at any time from Settings.
guide.general_theme_body: Choose light or dark, or leave it following your device's system setting.
guide.general_share_body: Share the app link with family and friends in one tap from Settings.
guide.hifz_start_body: Tap the graduation-cap icon on the Quran tab and choose “Memorize a surah”, or open any ayah and tap “Memorize from here” to start with that ayah and the next few.
guide.hifz_repeat_body: Choose the ayah range, how many times each ayah repeats, how many times the whole range repeats (or loop), and the pause between repeats for you to recite. Needs a reciter with per-ayah audio.
guide.hifz_hide_body: Tap the eye icon to show only each ayah's first word with the rest blurred. Tap an ayah to reveal it.
guide.hifz_review_body: Mark a surah memorized and reviews are scheduled after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60 and 120 days. Due reviews appear on the Quran tab, with an optional daily reminder.
guide.plan_goal_body: Tap the flag icon on the Quran tab to set pages per day. Each Mushaf page you open counts once a day; your streak and the last 7 days are shown.
guide.plan_khatma_body: Choose the 30-day Ramadan plan, 7 or 60 days, or any date. The app shows today's portion and continues at the first page you haven't read.
guide.plan_reminder_body: On by default; choose its time or turn it off in the reading plan.
guide.ayah_of_day_body: A new ayah at the top of the Quran tab every day. Tap it to open it in the Mushaf.
guide.share_image_title: Share an ayah as an image
guide.share_image_body: In the ayah window (or on the Ayah of the day), tap the image icon, pick a style, and share a designed image.
guide.audio_highlight_body: While a surah plays, the ayah being recited is highlighted and the page turns with it (for reciters with per-ayah audio, when the surah isn't downloaded).
guide.islamic_days_body: Under the prayer times: Ramadan, the two Eids, Arafah, Ashura, the Hijri new year, the White Days and Monday/Thursday fasts, each with a countdown.
guide.qada_body: In the Qada tab, add each missed prayer with + and remove one with − when you make it up. Long-press to type a number.
guide.tasbih_body: The last tab in Athkar: pick a dhikr and a target, tap the circle to count, and feel a vibration at the target. Totals are saved.
guide.notif_zikr_body: A different authentic dhikr or dua each time. Choose how often (15 minutes to 3 hours) and between which hours in Settings.
guide.notif_times_body: Choose when the sleep athkar and Friday sunan reminders arrive in Settings.
guide.notif_fasting_body: On by default: at 9 PM the evening before Mondays, Thursdays, the White Days, Arafah and Ashura.
guide.notif_ayah_day_body: On by default: the day's ayah every morning at 8 AM.

onboarding.step1_body: Read, listen and reflect on the Quran — plus prayer times, athkar and a daily hadith, all in one app.
onboarding.step2_body: Swipe between real Mushaf pages. Tap anywhere to show or hide the menu, and hold an ayah to see its translation and tafsir.
onboarding.step3_title: Save your place, return to it directly
onboarding.step3_body: Hold any ayah, then tap the bookmark icon to save that exact ayah, or drop a page-level stop sign from the top bar. Tap the bookmark icon on the Quran tab to jump straight back anytime.
onboarding.step4_body: Tap the play button on any page, or pick from 9 reciters in the top bar, and download your favorite recitation to listen offline.
onboarding.step5_body: Accurate prayer times for your location, plus a live compass pointing toward the Qiblah.
onboarding.step6_body: Morning and evening athkar, a daily hadith and helpful reminders — all customizable from Settings.
onboarding.step7_body: For more detail on every feature in the app, browse the User Guide from Settings anytime.
onboarding.hifz_body: Repeat any ayah or range as many times as you like with a pause to recite, hide the text to test yourself, and get spaced reviews so it stays firm.
onboarding.plan_body: Set a daily page goal, keep a streak, and plan a khatma: pick a finish date (or the 30-day Ramadan plan) and the app gives you today's portion.
onboarding.ayah_day_body: A new ayah every day on the Quran tab and each morning as a notification. Share any ayah as a beautiful image.
onboarding.tools_body: A tasbih counter in Athkar, a missed-prayers (qada) tracker and upcoming Islamic days with Sunnah fasting reminders in Prayer. The recited ayah is highlighted and pages turn with the recitation.

plan.title: Reading Plan
plan.khatma_hint: Choose when you want to finish and the app splits the remaining pages into a daily portion.
plan.khatma_complete: Khatma complete — may Allah accept it from you!

plan.reset_confirm: Reset this khatma? Its progress will be cleared.
plan.set_up_prompt: Set a daily reading goal or plan a khatma

hifz.title: Hifz (Memorization)
hifz.empty: Nothing yet. Tap “Memorize a surah” to start, or open any ayah and choose “Memorize from here”.
hifz.intro: Listen to each ayah repeated, recite it in the pause, then hide the text to test yourself. Mark a surah memorized and the app schedules reviews after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60 and 120 days.
hifz.reciter_unsupported: {} has no per-ayah recordings. Choose another reciter to use Hifz mode.
